title: controller-render-service
description: Stateless HTTP service previewing the CRDs a set of RestDefinitions would generate (POST /render). Required by the portal's Controller Builder Preview; the defaults here are correct for composition use, so installing it as a Krateo component needs no componentValues.

imageRegistry.title: Image registry override
imageRegistry.description: Overrides the registry HOST of the image (the repository path is preserved), for mirror / air-gapped installs.

image.title: Image
image.description: The oasgen-provider image; this chart runs its oasgen-render entrypoint rather than the controller, so the renderer cannot drift from the generator whose output it previews.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Overrides the image tag, whose default is the chart appVersion.

fullnameOverride.title: Fullname override
fullnameOverride.description: Names the Deployment, Service and selector labels, and is what the endpoint Secret's server-url is built from. Empty keeps the generated name, which as a Krateo component is exactly `controller-render-service`. Changing it on a running release fails the upgrade, because a Deployment's selector is immutable.

containerPort.title: Container port
containerPort.description: Port the binary listens on, passed as --addr. Matches service.port and blueprint-render-service.

podSecurityContext.title: Pod security context
podSecurityContext.description: Left empty by default, matching the oasgen-provider sub-deployment this chart replaces. Hardening it is a separate change that needs the image verified against a nonroot profile first.

securityContext.title: Container security context
securityContext.description: Left empty by default; see podSecurityContext.

snowplowEndpoint.title: Snowplow endpoint Secret
snowplowEndpoint.description: Publishes this Service's address as a Secret keyed by server-url, which snowplow RESTActions resolve via endpointRef. Default ON, like blueprint-render-service: the portal's controller-render-draft RESTAction always needs it.
